<MethodEndpoint
  method={"delete"}
  path={"/api/catalog_node_template/{local_name}/{slug}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Removes a node template from a catalog published from this grid.

Nodes already built from it are unaffected - a node owns a copy of its
template's files - and so are subscribers, until they pull a publish that
includes this removal.
